name: storagegateway
description: Storage Gateway Service Amazon FSx File Gateway is no longer available to new customers.

subcommands.name: activate-gateway
subcommands.description: Activates the gateway you previously deployed on your host.

subcommands.name: add-cache
subcommands.description: Configures one or more gateway local disks as cache for a gateway.

subcommands.name: add-tags-to-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: add-upload-buffer
subcommands.description: Configures one or more gateway local disks as upload buffer for a specified gateway.

subcommands.name: add-working-storage
subcommands.description: Configures one or more gateway local disks as working storage for a gateway.

subcommands.name: assign-tape-pool
subcommands.description: Assigns a tape to a tape pool for archiving.

subcommands.name: associate-file-system
subcommands.description: Associate an Amazon FSx file system with the FSx File Gateway.

subcommands.name: attach-volume
subcommands.description: Connects a volume to an iSCSI connection and then attaches the volume to the specified gateway.

subcommands.name: cancel-archival
subcommands.description: Cancels archiving of a virtual tape to the virtual tape shelf (VTS) after the archiving process is initiated.

subcommands.name: cancel-cache-report
subcommands.description: Cancels generation of a specified cache report.

subcommands.name: cancel-retrieval
subcommands.description: Cancels retrieval of a virtual tape from the virtual tape shelf (VTS) to a gateway after the retrieval process is initiated.

subcommands.name: create-cached-iscsi-volume
subcommands.description: Creates a cached volume on a specified cached volume gateway.

subcommands.name: create-nfs-file-share
subcommands.description: Creates a Network File System (NFS) file share on an existing S3 File Gateway.

subcommands.name: create-smb-file-share
subcommands.description: Creates a Server Message Block (SMB) file share on an existing S3 File Gateway.

subcommands.name: create-snapshot
subcommands.description: Initiates a snapshot of a volume.

subcommands.name: create-snapshot-from-volume-recovery-point
subcommands.description: Initiates a snapshot of a gateway from a volume recovery point.

subcommands.name: create-stored-iscsi-volume
subcommands.description: Creates a volume on a specified gateway.

subcommands.name: create-tape-pool
subcommands.description: Creates a new custom tape pool.

subcommands.name: create-tape-with-barcode
subcommands.description: Creates a virtual tape by using your own barcode.

subcommands.name: create-tapes
subcommands.description: Creates one or more virtual tapes.

subcommands.name: delete-automatic-tape-creation-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the automatic tape creation policy of a gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-bandwidth-rate-limit
subcommands.description: Deletes the bandwidth rate limits of a gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-cache-report
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified cache report and any associated tags from the Storage Gateway database.

subcommands.name: delete-chap-credentials
subcommands.description: Deletes Challenge-Handshake Authentication Protocol (CHAP) credentials for a specified iSCSI target and initiator pair.

subcommands.name: delete-file-share
subcommands.description: Deletes a file share from an S3 File Gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-gateway
subcommands.description: Deletes a gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-snapshot-schedule
subcommands.description: Deletes a snapshot of a volume.

subcommands.name: delete-tape
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified virtual tape.

subcommands.name: delete-tape-archive
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified virtual tape from the virtual tape shelf (VTS).

subcommands.name: delete-tape-pool
subcommands.description: Delete a custom tape pool.

subcommands.name: delete-volume
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified storage volume that you previously created using the CreateCachediSCSIVolume or CreateStorediSCSIVolume API.

subcommands.name: describe-availability-monitor-test
subcommands.description: Returns information about the most recent high availability monitoring test that was performed on the host in a cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-bandwidth-rate-limit
subcommands.description: Returns the bandwidth rate limits of a gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-bandwidth-rate-limit-schedule
subcommands.description: Returns information about the bandwidth rate limit schedule of a gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-cache
subcommands.description: Returns information about the cache of a gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-cache-report
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified cache report, including completion status and generation progress.

subcommands.name: describe-cached-iscsi-volumes
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the gateway volumes specified in the request.

subcommands.name: describe-chap-credentials
subcommands.description: Returns an array of Challenge-Handshake Authentication Protocol (CHAP) credentials information for a specified iSCSI target, one for each target-initiator pair.

subcommands.name: describe-file-system-associations
subcommands.description: Gets the file system association information.

subcommands.name: describe-gateway-information
subcommands.description: Returns metadata about a gateway such as its name, network interfaces, time zone, status, and software version.

subcommands.name: describe-maintenance-start-time
subcommands.description: Returns your gateway's maintenance window schedule information, with values for monthly or weekly cadence, specific day and time to begin maintenance, and which types of updates to apply.

subcommands.name: describe-nfs-file-shares
subcommands.description: Gets a description for one or more Network File System (NFS) file shares from an S3 File Gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-smb-file-shares
subcommands.description: Gets a description for one or more Server Message Block (SMB) file shares from a S3 File Gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-smb-settings
subcommands.description: Gets a description of a Server Message Block (SMB) file share settings from a file gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-snapshot-schedule
subcommands.description: Describes the snapshot schedule for the specified gateway volume.

subcommands.name: describe-stored-iscsi-volumes
subcommands.description: Returns the description of the gateway volumes specified in the request.

subcommands.name: describe-tape-archives
subcommands.description: Returns a description of specified virtual tapes in the virtual tape shelf (VTS).

subcommands.name: describe-tape-recovery-points
subcommands.description: Returns a list of virtual tape recovery points that are available for the specified tape gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-tapes
subcommands.description: Returns a description of virtual tapes that correspond to the specified Amazon Resource Names (ARNs).

subcommands.name: describe-upload-buffer
subcommands.description: Returns information about the upload buffer of a gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-vtl-devices
subcommands.description: Returns a description of virtual tape library (VTL) devices for the specified tape gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-working-storage
subcommands.description: Returns information about the working storage of a gateway.

subcommands.name: detach-volume
subcommands.description: Disconnects a volume from an iSCSI connection and then detaches the volume from the specified gateway.

subcommands.name: disable-gateway
subcommands.description: Disables a tape gateway when the gateway is no longer functioning.

subcommands.name: disassociate-file-system
subcommands.description: Disassociates an Amazon FSx file system from the specified gateway.

subcommands.name: evict-files-failing-upload
subcommands.description: Starts a process that cleans the specified file share's cache of file entries that are failing upload to Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: join-domain
subcommands.description: Adds a file gateway to an Active Directory domain.

subcommands.name: list-automatic-tape-creation-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the automatic tape creation policies for a gateway.

subcommands.name: list-cache-reports
subcommands.description: Returns a list of existing cache reports for all file shares associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-file-shares
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the file shares for a specific S3 File Gateway, or the list of file shares that belong to the calling Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-file-system-associations
subcommands.description: Gets a list of FileSystemAssociationSummary objects.

subcommands.name: list-gateways
subcommands.description: Lists gateways owned by an Amazon Web Services account in an Amazon Web Services Region specified in the request.

subcommands.name: list-local-disks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the gateway's local disks.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that have been added to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-tape-pools
subcommands.description: Lists custom tape pools.

subcommands.name: list-tapes
subcommands.description: Lists virtual tapes in your virtual tape library (VTL) and your virtual tape shelf (VTS).

subcommands.name: list-volume-initiators
subcommands.description: Lists iSCSI initiators that are connected to a volume.

subcommands.name: list-volume-recovery-points
subcommands.description: Lists the recovery points for a specified gateway.

subcommands.name: list-volumes
subcommands.description: Lists the iSCSI stored volumes of a gateway.

subcommands.name: notify-when-uploaded
subcommands.description: Sends you notification through Amazon EventBridge when all files written to your file share have been uploaded to Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: refresh-cache
subcommands.description: Refreshes the cached inventory of objects for the specified file share.

subcommands.name: remove-tags-from-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: reset-cache
subcommands.description: Resets all cache disks that have encountered an error and makes the disks available for reconfiguration as cache storage.

subcommands.name: retrieve-tape-archive
subcommands.description: Retrieves an archived virtual tape from the virtual tape shelf (VTS) to a tape gateway.

subcommands.name: retrieve-tape-recovery-point
subcommands.description: Retrieves the recovery point for the specified virtual tape.

subcommands.name: set-local-console-password
subcommands.description: Sets the password for your VM local console.

subcommands.name: set-smb-guest-password
subcommands.description: Sets the password for the guest user smbguest.

subcommands.name: shutdown-gateway
subcommands.description: Shuts down a Tape Gateway or Volume Gateway.

subcommands.name: start-availability-monitor-test
subcommands.description: Start a test that verifies that the specified gateway is configured for High Availability monitoring in your host environment.

subcommands.name: start-cache-report
subcommands.description: Starts generating a report of the file metadata currently cached by an S3 File Gateway for a specific file share.

subcommands.name: start-gateway
subcommands.description: Starts a gateway that you previously shut down (see ShutdownGateway).

subcommands.name: update-automatic-tape-creation-policy
subcommands.description: Updates the automatic tape creation policy of a gateway.

subcommands.name: update-bandwidth-rate-limit
subcommands.description: Updates the bandwidth rate limits of a gateway.

subcommands.name: update-bandwidth-rate-limit-schedule
subcommands.description: Updates the bandwidth rate limit schedule for a specified gateway.

subcommands.name: update-chap-credentials
subcommands.description: Updates the Challenge-Handshake Authentication Protocol (CHAP) credentials for a specified iSCSI target.

subcommands.name: update-file-system-association
subcommands.description: Updates a file system association.

subcommands.name: update-gateway-information
subcommands.description: Updates a gateway's metadata, which includes the gateway's name, time zone, and metadata cache size.

subcommands.name: update-gateway-software-now
subcommands.description: Updates the gateway virtual machine (VM) software.

subcommands.name: update-maintenance-start-time
subcommands.description: Updates a gateway's maintenance window schedule, with settings for monthly or weekly cadence, specific day and time to begin maintenance, and which types of updates to apply.

subcommands.name: update-nfs-file-share
subcommands.description: Updates a Network File System (NFS) file share.

subcommands.name: update-smb-file-share
subcommands.description: Updates a Server Message Block (SMB) file share.

subcommands.name: update-smb-file-share-visibility
subcommands.description: Controls whether the shares on an S3 File Gateway are visible in a net view or browse list.

subcommands.name: update-smb-local-groups
subcommands.description: Updates the list of Active Directory users and groups that have special permissions for SMB file shares on the gateway.

subcommands.name: update-smb-security-strategy
subcommands.description: Updates the SMB security strategy level for an Amazon S3 file gateway.

subcommands.name: update-snapshot-schedule
subcommands.description: Updates a snapshot schedule configured for a gateway volume.

subcommands.name: update-vtl-device-type
subcommands.description: Updates the type of medium changer in a tape gateway.
